title: Machine learning reveals sex differences in clinical features of acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: A multicenter cross-sectional study
summary: Retrospective clinical cohort of 359 AECOPD patients in which machine learning (K-prototype, logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost) identifies sex-associated clinical features, with a nomogram AUC of 0.945; a clinically specific distinct finding with an enabling ML role.
